import fnmatch


class CORSMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, allowed_origins: list[str], allowed_methods: list[str] | None = None):
        self.allowed_origins = allowed_origins
        self.allowed_methods = allowed_methods or ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE']

    def _extract_host(self, origin: str) -> str:
        """Extract hostname from an origin string (strip scheme, port, path)."""
        if not isinstance(origin, str):
            return ""
        o = origin.strip()
        if "://" in o:
            o = o.split("://", 1)[1]
        # strip path / query / fragment
        o = o.split("/", 1)[0]
        # strip userinfo
        if "@" in o:
            o = o.rsplit("@", 1)[1]
        # IPv6 literal e.g. [::1]:8080
        if o.startswith("["):
            end = o.find("]")
            if end != -1:
                return o[: end + 1]
            return o
        # strip port
        if ":" in o:
            o = o.split(":", 1)[0]
        return o

    def is_origin_allowed(self, origin: str) -> bool:
        """Check if the origin is in the allowlist. Supports wildcard patterns."""
        if not origin or not isinstance(origin, str):
            return False
        for pattern in self.allowed_origins:
            if not isinstance(pattern, str):
                continue
            if pattern == "*":
                return True
            if pattern == origin:
                return True
            if "*" in pattern:
                # Simple suffix wildcard without scheme, e.g. *.example.com
                if pattern.startswith("*."):
                    suffix = pattern[2:]
                    # suffix itself should not contain wildcard for this branch;
                    # if it does, fall back to fnmatch
                    if "*" not in suffix:
                        host = self._extract_host(origin)
                        if not host:
                            continue
                        if host.lower().endswith("." + suffix.lower()):
                            return True
                        continue
                # Generic wildcard: fnmatch on full origin (case-insensitive)
                try:
                    if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(origin.lower(), pattern.lower()):
                        return True
                except Exception:
                    pass
                # Fallback: try host-level fnmatch to allow port variations
                # e.g. pattern https://*.example.com should match
                # origin https://sub.example.com:8080
                try:
                    pattern_host = self._extract_host(pattern)
                    origin_host = self._extract_host(origin)
                    if pattern_host and origin_host:
                        if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(origin_host.lower(), pattern_host.lower()):
                            if "://" in pattern:
                                pattern_scheme = pattern.split("://", 1)[0].lower()
                                if "://" in origin:
                                    origin_scheme = origin.split("://", 1)[0].lower()
                                else:
                                    origin_scheme = ""
                                if pattern_scheme == origin_scheme:
                                    return True
                            else:
                                return True
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return False

    def handle_preflight(self, origin: str, method: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Handle OPTIONS preflight request. Returns response headers dict."""
        if not origin or not isinstance(origin, str):
            return {}
        if not self.is_origin_allowed(origin):
            return {}
        if not method or not isinstance(method, str):
            return {}
        allowed_upper = [m.upper() for m in self.allowed_methods]
        if method.upper() not in allowed_upper:
            return {}
        if "*" in self.allowed_origins:
            allow_origin = "*"
        else:
            allow_origin = origin
        return {
            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": allow_origin,
            "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": ", ".join(self.allowed_methods),
            "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
            "Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400",
        }

    def get_cors_headers(self, origin: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Get CORS headers for a regular request."""
        if not origin or not isinstance(origin, str):
            return {}
        if not self.is_origin_allowed(origin):
            return {}
        if "*" in self.allowed_origins:
            return {"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"}
        return {"Access-Control-Allow-Origin": origin}
